odbc_ini_path.description: The full path to this configuration file itself, as referenced by the ODBCSYSINI environment variable mechanism. Often self-referential in system configs.

odbc_inst_ini_path.description: The full path to the unixODBC driver configuration file.

datasources.description: A list of Data Source Name (DSN) definitions to register in the ODBC Data Sources section and define their connection parameters. Each item is a flat map with the following fields: 'name' (string, DSN name), 'driver' (string, driver name as registered in odbcinst.ini), 'driver_path' (string, absolute path to the .so/.dll), 'server' (string, hostname), 'database' (string, database name), 'username' (string, default UID), 'password' (string, default password), 'port' (number, default port), 'description' (string, DSN description).

datasources.items.description: Placeholder for schema flattening. The actual type is a list of objects.
